entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_STATION_SELECT
entry.description: Select one payload station, or a group with a common configured targeting mode. Param2 zero uses legacy station selection; nonzero param2 selects a mask and requires param1 zero.
entry.param: Station ID. Zero deselects the current station; stations are numbered from 1.
Optional bitmask: bit zero selects station 1. Zero uses param1.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_STATION_RELEASE
entry.description: Release all selected stations together in one control update.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_STATION_SET_ARMED
entry.description: Set the system-wide payload-release authorization state.
entry.param: Zero makes release SAFE; one ARMs release.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_STATION_AUTO_RELEASE
entry.description: Enable or disable one-shot automatic release of the selected payload station at closest approach to the ground target. Enabling requires an armed vehicle, selected available stations, and release authorization. Enabled intent is retained while targeting or guidance is unavailable; release is inhibited until all prerequisites are valid.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_SET_GROUND_TARGET
entry.description: Set the ground target used by TGTNG's inverse-aim guidance. Send in COMMAND_INT using MAV_FRAME_GLOBAL; param7 is target elevation AMSL. As a mission item a relative-to-home frame also works: the navigator adds the home altitude before handing the target over.
entry.param: Target elevation above mean sea level in metres.

entry.name: MAV_CMD_WINDHOVER_SET_GROUND_TRACK
entry.description: Enable or disable inverse-aim ground-track guidance. This never releases a payload.
entry.param: Optional approach bearing clockwise from north in degrees.
1 uses param2; otherwise derive bearing from aircraft to target on activation.

enum.name: STATION_CONTROL_GUIDANCE_OUTCOME
enum.description: How a ground-track guidance run ended.

entry.name: STATION_CONTROL_GUIDANCE_OUTCOME_MISSED_PASS
entry.description: The impact point crossed the target without a release.

entry.name: STATION_CONTROL_GUIDANCE_OUTCOME_PAST_TARGET
entry.description: The impact point is far beyond the target and never crossed it.

entry.name: STATION_CONTROL_GUIDANCE_OUTCOME_SOLUTION_LOST
entry.description: No valid impact solution for too long.

entry.name: STATION_CONTROL_ARM_SOURCE_RC
entry.description: Armed with the RC release-arm switch ON.

entry.name: STATION_CONTROL_ARM_SOURCE_COMMAND
entry.description: Armed by a command alone: the RC switch was OFF or not mapped.

message.name: TGTNG_IMPACT
message.description: Current and forward-projected payload impact solution from TGTNG. Angles use the vehicle body FRD frame.
message.field: PX4 monotonic publication time.
Oldest source-state sample time used by the current solution.
Current impact coordinates in the active local NED frame. Values are NaN when current_valid is zero.
Payload flight time for the current solution.
Current impact azimuth, zero forward and positive right.
Current impact elevation, zero in the body XY plane and positive upward.
Projected body-frame impact azimuths at equally spaced release times. Invalid entries are NaN.
Projected body-frame impact elevations at equally spaced release times. Invalid entries are NaN.
Time offset of projection sample seven.
Impact model identifier.

Impact-surface source: 0 none, 1 distance to the ground, 2 estimator terrain, 3 home altitude plus offset, 4 configured offset above mean sea level, 5 explicit ground-target elevation. 3 to 5 are assumed, not measured.
One when the current solution is valid.
Bit i validates projected sample i.
Release point above the impact surface.
Horizontal distance from the vehicle to the current impact point.
1-sigma impact-surface height uncertainty.
1-sigma time-to-impact uncertainty.
1-sigma horizontal uncertainty of the impact point in the local frame (geo-referenced aim).
1-sigma horizontal uncertainty of the impact point relative to the vehicle (visual aim).
1-sigma uncertainty of the current impact direction, including attitude.
Air-data source: 0 none, 1 airspeed sensor, 2 ground velocity minus EKF2 wind, 3 ground minus sideslip wind, 4 thrust based, 5 ground speed with zero wind assumed.
Best available true airspeed.
Estimated horizontal wind speed.
1-sigma horizontal wind uncertainty.
1 ground assumed (not measured), 2 estimator dead reckoning, 4 drag and wind not modeled, 8 wind unknown, 16 selected drag model has no mass or area (vacuum used).
Payload drag model of the current solution: 0 vacuum (also when the selected model was invalid), 1 to 4 TGTNG_DMn_MASS and TGTNG_DMn_CDA.
Release delay applied to the current solution: the selected station's STC_Sx_DELAY.
